summary.text: Jim Hinebaugh is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates for District 1A, covering Garrett and Allegany counties, elected in November 2022 and a member since January 11, 2023. His official page lists him on the Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Hinebaugh's official page says he was born in Oakland, Maryland, in 1946 and graduated from Southern Garrett High School in 1964.
It lists a B.S. in computer science and math from the University of Southern Mississippi in 1974 and an MBA in public administration from Shippensburg University.
It says he served 29 years in the U.S. Army and retired as a colonel, including company command in Vietnam and Germany and command of the Defense Distribution Center East.
The page lists him as Garrett County Director of Economic Development from 1995 to 2012 and a Garrett County Commissioner from 2014 to 2022.
It lists his military decorations as including the Defense Distinguished Service Medal, Legion of Merit and Bronze Star with V device, and says he is married with four children.
